insight.synastry.a-cross-chart-contact-s.en: A cross-chart contact showing how one person’s planet meets the other person’s natal pattern.
insight.synastry.a-cross-chart-contact-s.zh: 这是一条跨盘联系，显示一方行星如何触及另一方的本命结构。
insight.synastry.a-cross-chart-contact-s.es: Un contacto entre cartas que muestra cómo el planeta de una persona se encuentra con el patrón natal de la otra.
insight.synastry.a-cross-chart-contact-s.fr: Un contact entre deux cartes montrant comment la planète d’une personne rencontre le schéma natal de l’autre.
insight.synastry.a-cross-chart-contact-s.tr: Bir kişinin gezegeninin diğer kişinin doğum örüntüsüyle nasıl buluştuğunu gösteren haritalar arası bir temas.
insight.synastry.a-cross-chart-contact-s.de: Ein horoskopübergreifender Kontakt, der zeigt, wie der Planet einer Person auf das Radixmuster der anderen trifft.
insight.synastry.a-cross-chart-contact-s.it: Un contatto tra due temi che mostra come il pianeta di una persona incontra lo schema natale dell’altra.
insight.synastry.a-cross-chart-contact-s.ko: 한 사람의 행성이 다른 사람의 출생 패턴과 어떻게 만나는지 보여 주는 차트 간 접촉입니다.
insight.synastry.a-cross-chart-contact-s.pt-BR: A cross-chart contact showing how one person’s planet meets the other person’s natal pattern.

insight.synastry.mercury-contacts-descri.en: Mercury contacts describe comprehension, pace and conflict style.
insight.synastry.mercury-contacts-descri.zh: 水星联系描述理解方式、交流速度与冲突风格。
insight.synastry.mercury-contacts-descri.es: Los contactos de Mercurio describen la comprensión, el ritmo y el estilo de conflicto.
insight.synastry.mercury-contacts-descri.fr: Les contacts de Mercure décrivent la compréhension, le rythme et la manière de gérer les conflits.
insight.synastry.mercury-contacts-descri.tr: Merkür temasları anlama biçimini, tempoyu ve çatışma tarzını anlatır.

insight.synastry.mercury-contacts-descri.it: I contatti di Mercurio descrivono comprensione, ritmo e stile di conflitto.

insight.synastry.mercury-contacts-descri.pt-BR: Mercury contacts describe comprehension, pace and conflict style.

insight.synastry.moon-contacts-show-emot.en: Moon contacts show emotional recognition, regulation and pacing.
insight.synastry.moon-contacts-show-emot.zh: 月亮联系显示彼此如何识别、调节与同步情绪。
insight.synastry.moon-contacts-show-emot.es: Los contactos de la Luna muestran el reconocimiento emocional, la regulación y el ritmo.
insight.synastry.moon-contacts-show-emot.fr: Les contacts de la Lune montrent la reconnaissance émotionnelle, la régulation et le rythme.
insight.synastry.moon-contacts-show-emot.tr: Ay temasları duygusal tanımayı, düzenlemeyi ve tempoyu gösterir.
insight.synastry.moon-contacts-show-emot.de: Mondkontakte zeigen emotionale Wiedererkennung, Regulation und Tempo.

insight.synastry.moon-contacts-show-emot.pt-BR: Moon contacts show emotional recognition, regulation and pacing.

insight.synastry.saturn-jupiter-and-angl.en: Saturn, Jupiter and angle contacts show reliability, growth and structural pressure.
insight.synastry.saturn-jupiter-and-angl.zh: 土星、木星与角点联系显示可靠性、成长空间与结构压力。

insight.synastry.saturn-jupiter-and-angl.de: Saturn-, Jupiter- und Achsenkontakte zeigen Verlässlichkeit, Wachstum und strukturellen Druck.

insight.synastry.this-overview-separates.en: This overview separates relationship functions because the same connection can flow easily in one area and require adjustment in another.
insight.synastry.this-overview-separates.zh: 这张总览会分别呈现不同关系功能，因为同一段连接可能在一个领域自然顺畅，在另一个领域需要磨合。
insight.synastry.this-overview-separates.es: Este resumen separa las funciones de la relación porque una misma conexión puede fluir con facilidad en un área y requerir ajustes en otra.
insight.synastry.this-overview-separates.fr: Cette vue d’ensemble distingue les fonctions de la relation, car un même lien peut être fluide dans un domaine et demander des ajustements dans un autre.
insight.synastry.this-overview-separates.tr: Bu genel bakış ilişki işlevlerini ayırır; çünkü aynı bağlantı bir alanda kolay akarken başka bir alanda ayarlama gerektirebilir.
insight.synastry.this-overview-separates.de: Diese Übersicht trennt Beziehungsfunktionen, weil dieselbe Verbindung in einem Bereich leicht fließen und in einem anderen Anpassung erfordern kann.
insight.synastry.this-overview-separates.it: Questa panoramica separa le funzioni della relazione perché la stessa connessione può fluire facilmente in un’area e richiedere adattamento in un’altra.
insight.synastry.this-overview-separates.ko: 이 개요는 같은 연결이 한 영역에서는 자연스럽게 흐르고 다른 영역에서는 조정이 필요할 수 있으므로 관계 기능을 나누어 보여 줍니다.
insight.synastry.this-overview-separates.pt-BR: This overview separates relationship functions because the same connection can flow easily in one area and require adjustment in another.

insight.synastry.venus-and-mars-contacts.en: Venus and Mars contacts describe attraction and pursuit; other major contacts can add intensity.
insight.synastry.venus-and-mars-contacts.zh: 金星与火星联系描述吸引和追求，其他重要联系会增加强度。
insight.synastry.venus-and-mars-contacts.es: Los contactos de Venus y Marte describen la atracción y la iniciativa; otros contactos importantes pueden añadir intensidad.
insight.synastry.venus-and-mars-contacts.fr: Les contacts de Vénus et Mars décrivent l’attraction et l’élan ; d’autres contacts majeurs peuvent ajouter de l’intensité.
insight.synastry.venus-and-mars-contacts.tr: Venüs ve Mars temasları çekimi ve yönelmeyi anlatır; diğer majör temaslar yoğunluk katabilir.
insight.synastry.venus-and-mars-contacts.de: Venus- und Marskontakte beschreiben Anziehung und Annäherung; andere Hauptkontakte können zusätzliche Intensität bringen.
insight.synastry.venus-and-mars-contacts.it: I contatti di Venere e Marte descrivono attrazione e inseguimento; altri contatti maggiori possono aggiungere intensità.
insight.synastry.venus-and-mars-contacts.ko: 금성과 화성의 접촉은 끌림과 추구 방식을 설명하며, 다른 주요 접촉은 강도를 더할 수 있습니다.
insight.synastry.venus-and-mars-contacts.pt-BR: Venus and Mars contacts describe attraction and pursuit; other major contacts can add intensity.

insight.transit.a-planet-can-matter-beca.en: A planet can matter because of the house it occupies even when no exact natal aspect is active.
insight.transit.a-planet-can-matter-beca.zh: 即使没有正在生效的精确本命相位，行星也会因所处宫位而具有明确的领域重点。
insight.transit.a-planet-can-matter-beca.es: Un planeta puede ser importante por la casa que ocupa incluso cuando no hay ningún aspecto natal exacto activo.
insight.transit.a-planet-can-matter-beca.fr: Une planète peut compter en raison de la maison qu’elle occupe, même lorsqu’aucun aspect natal exact n’est actif.
insight.transit.a-planet-can-matter-beca.tr: Bir gezegen, kesin bir doğum açısı aktif olmasa bile bulunduğu ev nedeniyle önemli olabilir.
insight.transit.a-planet-can-matter-beca.de: Ein Planet kann aufgrund des Hauses, in dem er steht, bedeutsam sein, auch wenn kein exakter Radixaspekt aktiv ist.
insight.transit.a-planet-can-matter-beca.it: Un pianeta può essere importante per la casa che occupa anche quando non è attivo alcun aspetto natale esatto.
insight.transit.a-planet-can-matter-beca.ko: 정확한 출생 애스펙트가 활성화되지 않아도 행성이 위치한 하우스 때문에 중요할 수 있습니다.
insight.transit.a-planet-can-matter-beca.pt-BR: A planet can matter because of the house it occupies even when no exact natal aspect is active.

insight.transit.activity-reflects-transi.en: Activity reflects transiting houses, activated natal planets and overlapping exact contacts. It is not a fortune or success score.
insight.transit.activity-reflects-transi.zh: 活动度反映行运行星落宫、被触发的本命星体与重叠的精确接触；它不是运气或成功评分。
insight.transit.activity-reflects-transi.es: La actividad refleja las casas transitadas, los planetas natales activados y los contactos exactos superpuestos. No es una puntuación de fortuna ni de éxito.
insight.transit.activity-reflects-transi.fr: L’activité reflète les maisons transitées, les planètes natales activées et les contacts exacts qui se chevauchent. Ce n’est pas un score de chance ou de réussite.
insight.transit.activity-reflects-transi.tr: Etkinlik; transit evlerini, etkinleşen doğum gezegenlerini ve çakışan kesin temasları yansıtır. Bir şans veya başarı puanı değildir.
insight.transit.activity-reflects-transi.de: Aktivität spiegelt Transithäuser, aktivierte Radixplaneten und sich überlagernde exakte Kontakte wider. Sie ist kein Glücks- oder Erfolgswert.
insight.transit.activity-reflects-transi.it: L’attività riflette le case di transito, i pianeti natali attivati e i contatti esatti sovrapposti. Non è un punteggio di fortuna o successo.
insight.transit.activity-reflects-transi.ko: 활동도는 트랜짓 하우스, 활성화된 출생 행성, 겹치는 정확 접촉을 반영합니다. 운이나 성공 점수가 아닙니다.
insight.transit.activity-reflects-transi.pt-BR: Activity reflects transiting houses, activated natal planets and overlapping exact contacts. It is not a fortune or success score.

insight.transit.planet-paths-shows-locat.en: Planet Paths shows location and motion. Active Transits shows exact relationships to natal planets and points.

insight.transit.planet-paths-shows-locat.es: Trayectorias planetarias muestra la ubicación y el movimiento. Tránsitos activos muestra las relaciones exactas con planetas y puntos natales.
insight.transit.planet-paths-shows-locat.fr: Trajectoires planétaires montre la position et le mouvement. Transits actifs montre les relations exactes avec les planètes et points natals.
insight.transit.planet-paths-shows-locat.tr: Gezegen Yolları konumu ve hareketi gösterir. Aktif Transitler doğum gezegenleri ve noktalarıyla kesin ilişkileri gösterir.
insight.transit.planet-paths-shows-locat.de: Planetenpfade zeigen Position und Bewegung. Aktive Transite zeigen exakte Beziehungen zu Radixplaneten und -punkten.
insight.transit.planet-paths-shows-locat.it: Percorsi planetari mostra posizione e movimento. Transiti attivi mostra le relazioni esatte con pianeti e punti natali.
insight.transit.planet-paths-shows-locat.ko: 행성 경로는 위치와 운동을 보여 줍니다. 활성 트랜짓은 출생 행성 및 포인트와의 정확한 관계를 보여 줍니다.
insight.transit.planet-paths-shows-locat.pt-BR: Planet Paths shows location and motion. Active Transits shows exact relationships to natal planets and points.

insight.transit.this-module-shows-each-t.en: This module shows each transiting planet's sign, natal house, direction and next calculated ingress or station.
insight.transit.this-module-shows-each-t.zh: 这里显示每颗行运行星的星座、本命宫位、运动方向，以及下一次已计算的换座、换宫或转向。
insight.transit.this-module-shows-each-t.es: Este módulo muestra el signo, la casa natal, la dirección y el próximo ingreso o estacionamiento calculado de cada planeta en tránsito.
insight.transit.this-module-shows-each-t.fr: Ce module affiche, pour chaque planète en transit, son signe, sa maison natale, sa direction et sa prochaine entrée ou station calculée.
insight.transit.this-module-shows-each-t.tr: Bu modül her transit gezegeninin burcunu, doğum evini, yönünü ve hesaplanan bir sonraki burç girişi veya durağanlaşmasını gösterir.
insight.transit.this-module-shows-each-t.de: Dieses Modul zeigt für jeden Transitplaneten Zeichen, Radixhaus, Bewegungsrichtung und den nächsten berechneten Ingress oder Stationspunkt.
insight.transit.this-module-shows-each-t.it: Questo modulo mostra per ogni pianeta in transito il segno, la casa natale, la direzione e il prossimo ingresso o stazionamento calcolato.
insight.transit.this-module-shows-each-t.ko: 이 모듈은 각 트랜짓 행성의 별자리, 출생 하우스, 방향, 다음 계산된 진입 또는 정지 전환을 보여 줍니다.
insight.transit.this-module-shows-each-t.pt-BR: This module shows each transiting planet's sign, natal house, direction and next calculated ingress or station.

insight.transit.this-separates-planetary.en: This separates planetary location from aspect interpretation.
insight.transit.this-separates-planetary.zh: 这里将行星位置与相位解读分开呈现。
insight.transit.this-separates-planetary.es: Esto separa la posición planetaria de la interpretación de aspectos.
insight.transit.this-separates-planetary.fr: Cela sépare la position planétaire de l’interprétation des aspects.
insight.transit.this-separates-planetary.tr: Bu, gezegen konumunu açı yorumundan ayırır.
insight.transit.this-separates-planetary.de: Damit wird die Planetenposition von der Aspektdeutung getrennt.
insight.transit.this-separates-planetary.it: Questo separa la posizione planetaria dall’interpretazione degli aspetti.
insight.transit.this-separates-planetary.ko: 행성 위치와 애스펙트 해석을 분리해 보여 줍니다.
insight.transit.this-separates-planetary.pt-BR: This separates planetary location from aspect interpretation.

insight.transit.timing-orb-house-and-mot.en: Timing, orb, house and motion are calculated for the selected chart moment and time zone.
insight.transit.timing-orb-house-and-mot.zh: 时间、容许度、宫位和运动状态均按当前选择的星盘时刻与时区计算。
insight.transit.timing-orb-house-and-mot.es: La hora, el orbe, la casa y el movimiento se calculan para el momento y la zona horaria seleccionados.
insight.transit.timing-orb-house-and-mot.fr: L’heure, l’orbe, la maison et le mouvement sont calculés pour le moment et le fuseau horaire sélectionnés.
insight.transit.timing-orb-house-and-mot.tr: Zamanlama, orb, ev ve hareket seçilen harita anı ve saat dilimi için hesaplanır.
insight.transit.timing-orb-house-and-mot.de: Timing, Orb, Haus und Bewegung werden für den ausgewählten Horoskopzeitpunkt und die Zeitzone berechnet.
insight.transit.timing-orb-house-and-mot.it: Tempistica, orb, casa e movimento sono calcolati per il momento del tema e il fuso orario selezionati.
insight.transit.timing-orb-house-and-mot.ko: 타이밍, 오브, 하우스, 운동은 선택한 차트 시각과 시간대를 기준으로 계산됩니다.
insight.transit.timing-orb-house-and-mot.pt-BR: Timing, orb, house and motion are calculated for the selected chart moment and time zone.
